content.short: Circuit Protocol is Mantle's native yield optimizer offering auto-compounded strategies for the highest sustainable yield across the network.
content.description: Circuit Protocol is a yield aggregator built natively for the Mantle Network, designed to maximize returns on Mantle-based DeFi positions through automatic compounding of farming rewards from the network's leading DEXes and lending protocols. As a Mantle-native protocol, Circuit is deeply integrated with the ecosystem's core DeFi primitives, ensuring users always have access to the best available yield opportunities without manually harvesting rewards.
